resources.string: Choose a real DSH session on this phone or a connected computer for floating chat and pause controls.
Your phone and computer keep separate conversations, files, and settings. A computer workspace needs no Ubuntu environment on this phone.
Run DSH on this phone with local conversations and files.
No paired computers yet. Pair once to remember your computer. You can revoke trust any time.

Enable DSHA Connect in DSH on your computer and display its pairing QR code. Scan it, or paste the complete pairing code shown there. The code expires shortly; keep it private. If an already paired computer changes network or addresses, scan its Refresh connection addresses QR code.
Checking computer trust on this phone…
This computer is not trusted yet. Display its first pairing QR code.
This computer is already paired. Display its Refresh connection addresses QR code. Existing trust is kept.

Computer: %1$s
Identity: %2$s
New connection addresses: %3$d

Update addresses only after verifying the pinned computer identity, existing connection key, and current process. Keep existing grants. Verification failure leaves the old record unchanged.
Verifying computer and new addresses. Connection records update only after success.
Scan the pairing QR shown in DSH on your computer. Camera frames are decoded on this phone.
Camera unavailable. Go back and paste a pairing code.
Invalid or expired pairing code. Refresh it on your computer and try again.

Computer: %1$s
Identity: %2$s

Remember this computer, connect to its DSH conversations and files, and allow phone assistant capabilities you have authorized. Android system permissions still need separate approval. You can revoke trust in Workspaces.

Continue only if you generated this code on your own computer.
Revoking %1$s ends its current connection and grants. Pair again to reconnect. Computer files and conversations are kept.
Operation did not complete. Please retry. Business operations are never automatically repeated.
Computer trust records could not be read. Existing records have been kept.
Connection interrupted. Reconnecting and verifying within a limited window. Business operations will not be resent.
Connection interrupted. Reconnect when ready; business operations will not be resent.
Connection incomplete. Check computer DSH and network, then retry.
Verifying pairing. Computer trust is saved only after success.
